requirements.protection: Age/emancipation gate, valid emancipation pathway and boundary-date handling.
requirements.limitation: Upstream age data accuracy and authenticity of emancipation evidence are not established by a workflow test.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect date boundaries, emancipation evidence and authorized guardian pathway; compare rejected eligible cases.
requirements.potential_harm: Eligible young applicants excluded or ineligible applicants enrolled.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Upstream age data accuracy and authenticity of emancipation evidence are not established by a workflow test.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Verify lawful presence, Utah residency and successful proofing; deny on failure with specific reason.
requirements.limitation: Tests cannot verify upstream eligibility data accuracy; expert review is point-in-time.
requirements.evidence_needed: Verify evidence provenance and freshness, disputed records, distinct denial reasons and correction pathway.
requirements.potential_harm: Erroneous eligibility decisions exclude eligible applicants.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests cannot verify upstream eligibility data accuracy; expert review is point-in-time.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Minimum necessary data for proofing and eligibility; no supplementary marketing, analytics or profiling; justified field mappings.
requirements.limitation: Field mappings do not establish necessity; annual audit cannot inspect runtime flows.
requirements.evidence_needed: Compare actual request and SDK/network data with documented purposes; challenge field necessity.
requirements.potential_harm: Excess collection and secondary processing during enrollment.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Field mappings do not establish necessity; annual audit cannot inspect runtime flows.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Enumerated name, date of birth, address, lawful presence and residency evidence; additional strictly necessary fields justified in published rules.
requirements.limitation: Automated checks cannot determine strict necessity; later changes may evade expert review.
requirements.evidence_needed: Rule-to-field and field-to-purpose mapping, alternative evidence routes and runtime data flows.
requirements.potential_harm: Unjustified collection exposes identity information or creates barriers.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Automated checks cannot determine strict necessity; later changes may evade expert review.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Feasible detection controls SHOULD exist; denial/revocation procedures SHALL exist for confirmed fraud; referral and case resolution.
requirements.limitation: Detection effectiveness and material falsity require judgment; novel fraud not covered by static tests.
requirements.evidence_needed: Separate anomaly, error, substantiated knowing material falsehood and authorized decision; inspect review and correction records.
requirements.potential_harm: Fraudulent endorsement or erroneous fraud finding harms legitimate holders.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Detection effectiveness and material falsity require judgment; novel fraud not covered by static tests.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Generally accepted standard and documented assurance level selected through Department rulemaking; proofing procedures meet the claimed level.
requirements.limitation: Structural alignment does not establish achieved assurance; drift and actual operations may not be captured.
requirements.evidence_needed: Obtain approved standard/version and level, independent procedure assessment and evidence of continued operation.
requirements.potential_harm: Unjustified proofing assurance enables impersonation or exclusion.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Structural alignment does not establish achieved assurance; drift and actual operations may not be captured.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Documented, sound and periodically reviewed risk assessment for impersonation, fraud and misuse; proportionate assurance level.
requirements.limitation: Methodological rigor and proportionality require expert judgment; threat landscape changes.
requirements.evidence_needed: Examine threat and affected-person contexts, chosen level, alternatives, exclusion and privacy burdens, review history.
requirements.potential_harm: Under-proofing enables impersonation; excessive proofing excludes or over-collects.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Methodological rigor and proportionality require expert judgment; threat landscape changes.

requirements.protection: Strictly necessary biometric collection, retention/deletion schedule and deletion, no persistent surveillance risk, privacy impact assessment.
requirements.limitation: Technical deletion tests do not establish necessity or cover all operational deviations.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inventory biometrics, processors, copies/backups, retention and deletion evidence; inspect privacy impact assessment and access controls.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Technical deletion tests do not establish necessity or cover all operational deviations.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Four verified assertions (existence/liveness, binding to claimed person, birth date, eligibility); block issuance if any missing.
requirements.limitation: Tests establish structural gate, not upstream evidence accuracy or reliability of assertion generation.
requirements.evidence_needed: Exercise absent, false, stale and inconsistent assertion evidence; verify authoritative source provenance, binding and issuance gate.
requirements.potential_harm: Incorrect binding or eligibility can produce fraudulent endorsement or erroneous denial.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests establish structural gate, not upstream evidence accuracy or reliability of assertion generation.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Assurance level sufficient for government/private-sector online age reliance and published relying-party guidance.
requirements.limitation: Sufficiency is a policy/trust determination; publication does not establish adoption.
requirements.evidence_needed: Review use-case-specific acceptance policy, assurance rationale and profile evidence; distinguish proofing from predicate proof and current holder binding.
requirements.potential_harm: Unsupported age reliance harms individuals or excludes valid users.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Sufficiency is a policy/trust determination; publication does not establish adoption.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Same proofing requirements regardless of intended online/offline presentation mode; technically suitable credentials.
requirements.limitation: Same workflow does not establish functional equivalence of presentations.
requirements.evidence_needed: Compare proofing requirements and issued credential suitability across modes; separate proofing from presentation status/privacy assurance.
requirements.potential_harm: False equivalence claim conceals presentation-mode weaknesses.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Same workflow does not establish functional equivalence of presentations.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Point-in-time endorsement; no continuous re-verification, heartbeat or tracking for validity; defined renewal intervals.
requirements.limitation: Application checks miss infrastructure monitoring; review does not detect later changes.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect renewal policy, credential semantics, infrastructure callbacks and status data flows; distinguish endorsement time from current status.
requirements.potential_harm: Tracking or false claim of continuously verified identity/attributes.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Application checks miss infrastructure monitoring; review does not detect later changes.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: No physical document surrender, cancellation or replacement in application; procedures prohibit surrender.
requirements.limitation: Review cannot cover every enrollment location or informal practice.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect procedures and representative enrollment encounters; distinguish inspection from compulsory relinquishment.
requirements.potential_harm: Loss of physical alternative or exclusion through document surrender.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Review cannot cover every enrollment location or informal practice.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Rule-defined acceptable proofing methods and conditions; in-person plus remote/hybrid SHOULD be supported for accessibility.
requirements.limitation: Tests cannot judge appropriateness; reviews cannot establish continued real availability.
requirements.evidence_needed: Inspect approved methods, conditions, comparable assurance, actual accessibility and operational availability.
requirements.potential_harm: Disproportionate or unavailable proofing paths exclude applicants.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests cannot judge appropriateness; reviews cannot establish continued real availability.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Published competency, security and compliance criteria, authorization process, authorized entity at launch and periodic reauthorization.
requirements.limitation: Administrative evidence does not establish ongoing operational practices between reviews.
requirements.evidence_needed: Check approved authority, scope, registry and reauthorization evidence; examine authorization withdrawal and reliance on stale approvals.
requirements.potential_harm: Unqualified or no-longer-authorized proofing entity supplies unreliable identity evidence.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Administrative evidence does not establish ongoing operational practices between reviews.

source_gaps.observation: Indexed as independence from physical ID system; Annex E/G show AUTO as primary control type, and Part 3 p92 describes independence in its informative mapping. No standalone IDP-08 requirement/assessment-objective section found in the retained Part 3 PDF. APP-08 on pp82–84 is a different requirement, not a substitute.
source_gaps.potential_harm: Digital enrollment may depend on physical ID issuance or vice versa, undermining independent access.
source_gaps.evidence_needed: Obtain publisher clarification or complete source section with normative wording, numbered objectives and method applicability. Preserve the observed source baseline.

contributor_web_observation.observation: Contributor reports that the anchor exists but does not lead to the appropriate text. Not independently verified in this increment.
contributor_web_observation.interpretation: Do not infer that APP-08 was mislabelled or substitute its fraud text for IDP-08; publisher clarification remains required.

source_gaps.protection: Intended independence of the physical and digital identity systems, as indicated by the index and informative mappings; detailed normative protection is unavailable.
source_gaps.disposition_rationale: Publisher clarification is required because the indexed requirement has no located detailed section; testing another requirement cannot establish the missing objectives or method applicability.
source_gaps.reassessment_trigger: Publisher supplies the detailed section or an accountable reviewer approves a bounded source-gap disposition; neither event counts as an examination of missing source content.

local_risks.name: Incorrect or fraudulent proofing assertions
local_risks.harm: Wrong identity endorsement, fraudulent access or unjustified denial
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID01 concerns Sybil proliferation; RK-ID03 concerns IDVP compromise. Neither directly captures incorrect individual proofing assertions or confirmed-fraud decision boundaries.

local_risks.name: Disproportionate or unsupported proofing assurance
local_risks.harm: Impersonation under insufficient assurance or exclusion/privacy harm under excessive assurance
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID02 and RK-HX04 capture related exclusion but not proofing level selection and operational accessibility.

local_risks.name: Unqualified or stale proofing authority
local_risks.harm: Identity evidence accepted from an unauthorized or noncompliant proofing entity
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID03 is related but assumes breach or deregistration rather than initial competence and ongoing authorization.

cases.constructed: Under-18 non-emancipated applicant has verified guardian consent but age gate rejects the application unconditionally.
cases.evidence: Clarify APP-01 objective 2 alongside APP-02/03; test eligible adult, emancipated minor, guardian-consented minor, unauthorized minor and date boundaries. Do not silently rewrite the source objective.

cases.constructed: All four assertion fields present, but upstream identity/residency data is stale or wrong; applicant is denied or flagged for fraud.
cases.evidence: Verify source accuracy and freshness, actual binding, reason codes, distinction between error and knowing material falsehood, appeal/correction and authorization of any revocation.

cases.constructed: Nominal proofing level is raised for age reliance; only a biometric remote route is practically available.
cases.evidence: Rule-defined assurance selection, contextual necessity, available alternative routes, comparative assurance and disparate outcomes. Part 3 pp90–92 NIST mapping is informative, not an adopted mandatory level.

cases.constructed: Previously authorized proofing entity continues supplying assertions after its authorization lapses or scope changes.
cases.evidence: Examine current registry, scope and decision evidence, reauthorization and stale-authority handling; establish responsibility for affected credentials without presuming automatic revocation.

limitations: IDP-08 has corroborating summary references but no standalone objective/method record in the retained Part 3; completeness cannot pass until qualified resolution.
APP-01 objective 2 appears unqualified by APP-02/03 guardian pathways; retain as clarification question, not legal conclusion.
NIST mapping pp90–92 is informative; selected proofing standard/level remains Department rulemaking decision.
No operational evidence, legal determination, guardrail verification, independent review or scoring.
